exam.title: بنك الأسئلة الشامل للغة الإنجليزية - الجامعة الافتراضية (الجزء السابع)
exam.description: الأسئلة من 601 إلى 700 - مع شرح مفصل لكل إجابة

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT passive sentence. (A new hospital will build.)
options: A new hospital will be built.
questions.explanation: 🔍 مع 'will' في المجهول: will + be + V3. 'A new hospital will be built' = سيتم بناء مستشفى جديد. 'will build' (معلوم) و'is built' و'was built' لا تعبر عن المستقبل بشكل صحيح.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT passive sentence. (Someone has stolen my car.)
questions.explanation: 🔍 المضارع التام في المجهول: has/have + been + V3. 'has been stolen' = تمت سرقتها. 'was stolen' للماضي البسيط، و'is stolen' للحاضر، و'had been stolen' للماضي التام.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT passive sentence. (People speak English.)
questions.explanation: 🔍 المضارع البسيط في المجهول: is/am/are + V3. 'English is spoken' = يتم التحدث بالإنجليزية (حقيقة عامة). 'was' للماضي، و'has been' للتمام، و'is being' للمستمر.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT passive sentence. (They have built a new bridge.)
options: A new bridge has been built.
A new bridge had been built.
questions.explanation: 🔍 المضارع التام في المجهول: has/have + been + V3. 'has been built' = تم بناؤها. 'was built' للماضي البسيط، و'is built' للحاضر، و'had been built' للماضي التام.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT passive sentence. (They had finished the work.)
questions.explanation: 🔍 الماضي التام في المجهول: had + been + V3. 'had been finished' = كانت قد انتهت. 'was' و'has been' و'is' لا تعبر عن الماضي التام.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT passive sentence. (The government is building new schools.)
questions.explanation: 🔍 المضارع المستمر في المجهول: am/is/are + being + V3. 'are being built' = يتم بناؤها حالياً. 'are built' للحقائق، و'have been' للتمام، و'were being' للماضي المستمر.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT passive sentence. (The chef was cooking dinner.)
questions.explanation: 🔍 الماضي المستمر في المجهول: was/were + being + V3. 'was being cooked' = كان يتم طهيها. 'was cooked' للماضي البسيط، و'has been' للتمام، و'is being' للحاضر المستمر.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT passive sentence. (They will have completed the bridge.)
options: The bridge will have been completed.
questions.explanation: 🔍 المستقبل التام في المجهول: will have been + V3. 'will have been completed' = سيكون قد تم إكمالها. 'will be' للمستقبل البسيط، و'has been' للتمام، و'was' للماضي.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT conditional sentence. (If I see him, I will tell him.)
options: If I will see him, I will tell him.
If I see him, I will tell him.
If I saw him, I will tell him.
If I see him, I tell him.
questions.explanation: 🔍 First conditional: if + present + will + V1. 'If I see him, I will tell him' = إذا رأيته، سأخبره. لا نستخدم 'will' في جملة 'if'، و'saw' للشرط الثاني، و'I tell' للمضارع البسيط.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT conditional sentence. (If I had known, I would have helped.)
options: If I had known, I would have helped.
If I knew, I would have helped.
If I have known, I would have helped.
If I had known, I will help.
questions.explanation: 🔍 Third conditional: if + past perfect + would have + V3. 'had known' و'would have helped' = لو كنت قد عرفت، لكنت ساعدت. 'knew' للشرط الثاني، و'have known' غير صحيحة.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT conditional sentence. (If she had studied, she would have passed.)
options: If she had studied, she would have passed.
If she studied, she would have passed.
If she has studied, she would have passed.
If she had studied, she will pass.
questions.explanation: 🔍 Third conditional: had studied → would have passed. 'studied' للشرط الثاني، و'has studied' للحاضر التام، و'will pass' للمستقبل.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT question tag. (She has been very kind, hasn't she?)
options: She has been very kind, isn't she?
She has been very kind, hasn't she?
She has been very kind, doesn't she?
She has been very kind, wasn't she?
questions.explanation: 🔍 المذيل مع المضارع التام: hasn't she. الفعل المساعد هو 'has'، لذا المذيل 'hasn't she'. 'isn't' و'doesn't' و'wasn't' لا تتبع 'has'.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT question tag. (You've been to France, haven't you?)
options: You've been to France, haven't you?
You've been to France, have you?
You've been to France, didn't you?
You've been to France, did you?
questions.explanation: 🔍 المذيل مع المضارع التام: haven't you. الجملة مثبتة ('have been')، لذا المذيل منفي 'haven't you'. 'have you' مثبت (خطأ)، و'didn't' و'did' للماضي البسيط.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT question tag. (Let's do something interesting, shall we?)
options: Let's do something interesting, don't we?
Let's do something interesting, do we?
Let's do something interesting, shall we?
Let's do something interesting, can't we?
questions.explanation: 🔍 المذيل مع 'Let's' هو 'shall we' دائماً. هذه قاعدة ثابتة. 'don't we' و'do we' و'can't we' غير صحيحة مع 'Let's'.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT question tag. (Don't be late, will you?)
questions.explanation: 🔍 مع الأمر المنفي: Don't + V1, will you? 'Don't be late, will you?' = لا تتأخر، حسناً؟ 'is you' و'do you' و'don't you' غير صحيحة.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT reported speech. (He said he would make up his mind the following day.)
options: He said he makes up his mind the following day.
He said he would make up his mind the following day.
He said he has made up his mind the following day.
He said he had made up his mind the following day.
questions.explanation: 🔍 الكلام المنقول: 'will' → 'would'. 'He said he would make up his mind the following day' = قال إنه سيتخذ قراره في اليوم التالي. 'makes' و'has made' و'had made' لا تعبر عن المستقبل في الكلام المنقول.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT reported speech. (He told me he didn't want any trouble.)
options: He told me he didn't want any trouble.
He told me he doesn't want any trouble.
He told me he hadn't wanted any trouble.
He told me he won't want any trouble.
questions.explanation: 🔍 الكلام المنقول: 'don't' → 'didn't'. 'He told me he didn't want any trouble' = أخبرني أنه لا يريد أي مشكلة. 'doesn't' للحاضر، و'hadn't wanted' للماضي التام، و'won't' للمستقبل.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT indirect question. (Could you tell me where the station is?)
options: Could you tell me where the station is?
Could you tell me where is the station?
Could you tell me where the station?
Could you tell me where is station?
questions.explanation: 🔍 في السؤال غير المباشر: فاعل + فعل. 'where the station is' = أين المحطة. 'where is' خطأ، و'where the station' غير مكتملة.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT indirect question. (I want to know what his real name is.)
options: I want to know what is his real name.
I want to know what his real name is.
I want to know what his real name.
I want to know what was his real name.
questions.explanation: 🔍 في السؤال غير المباشر: فاعل + فعل. 'what his real name is' = ما اسمه الحقيقي. 'what is' خطأ، و'what his real name' غير مكتملة، و'was' للماضي.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT comparative sentence. (She is taller than her sister.)
options: She is more taller than her sister.
She is taller than her sister.
She is tall than her sister.
She is more tall than her sister.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Tall' صفة قصيرة → 'taller than'. 'more taller' مزدوجة، و'tall than' بدون 'er'، و'more tall' غير صحيحة.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT comparative sentence. (He is the most intelligent student in the class.)
options: He is the most intelligent student in the class.
He is the intelligenter student in the class.
He is the most intelligent than the class.
He is more intelligent in the class.
questions.explanation: 🔍 Superlative: the most + صفة طويلة. 'intelligenter' خطأ، و'than' مع 'most' خطأ، و'more...in' غير صحيحة للتفضيل.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT comparative sentence. (Math is as difficult as chemistry.)
options: Math is as difficult than chemistry.
Math is as difficult as chemistry.
Math is more difficult as chemistry.
Math is the most difficult as chemistry.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'As + adjective + as' للمساواة. 'as difficult as chemistry' = بنفس صعوبة الكيمياء. 'than' و'more' و'the most' لا تستخدم مع 'as...as'.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT comparative sentence. (The more we walk, the faster we arrive.)
options: The more we walk, the faster we arrive.
The more we walk, the fast we arrive.
The most we walk, the faster we arrive.
The more we walk, the faster we arrived.
questions.explanation: 🔍 صيغة المقارنة المزدوجة: the + comparative, the + comparative. 'the more...the faster' = كلما...كلما. 'fast' ليست مقارنة، و'most' خطأ، و'arrived' للماضي.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT article. (People in England talk about the weather.)
options: People in England talk about weather.
People in England talk about a weather.
People in England talk about the weather.
People in England talk about weathers.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'The weather' = شيء محدد ومعروف. 'weather' غير معدود، لذا لا نستخدم 'a' ولا 'weathers'. 'the' ضرورية لأن الطقس شيء معروف.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT article. (The Chinese eat a lot of vegetables.)
options: Chinese eat a lot of vegetables.
The Chinese eat a lot of vegetables.
A Chinese eat a lot of vegetables.
Chineses eat a lot of vegetables.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'The + nationality' للإشارة إلى الشعب. 'The Chinese' = الشعب الصيني. 'Chinese' بدون 'the' تشير إلى اللغة، و'A Chinese' لشخص واحد، و'Chineses' خطأ.

questions.question: Choose the CORRECT article. (I met a man who took your book.)
options: I met a man who took your book.
I met an man who took your book.
I met the man who took your book.
I met man who took your book.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'A man' = للمرة الأولى. 'an man' خطأ لأن 'man' يبدأ بحرف ساكن، و'the man' للمرة الثانية، و'man' بدون أداة خطأ.

questions.question: I want to ______ a new job. I really don't like the one I'm doing now.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Look for' = يبحث عن. 'I want to look for a new job' = أريد البحث عن وظيفة جديدة. 'Give up' تعني 'يتخلى عن'، و'Find out' تعني 'يكتشف'.

questions.question: If you want to ______ people you should be a nurse.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Look after' = يعتني بـ. 'look after people' = يعتني بالناس. الممرضات يعتنين بالمرضى. 'Look for' تعني 'يبحث عن'.

questions.question: Take lots of petrol in case you ______ in the middle of the desert.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Break down' = يتعطل. السيارة قد تتعطل في الصحراء. 'Look for' تعني 'يبحث'، و'Give up' تعني 'يستسلم'.

questions.question: I'm going to ______ drinking!
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Give up' = يقلع عن، يتوقف عن. 'give up drinking' = أقلع عن الشرب. 'Find out' تعني 'يكتشف'، و'Look after' تعني 'يعتني'.

questions.question: They ______ the meeting for a week.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Put off' = يؤجل. 'put off the meeting' = أجل الاجتماع. 'Take off' تعني 'يخلع' أو 'تقلع'، و'Break down' تعني 'يتعطل'.

questions.question: ______ the heater before you go.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Turn off' = يطفئ. 'turn off the heater' = أطفئ المدفأة. 'Turn on' تعني 'يشغل' (عكس المعنى)، و'Plug in' تعني 'يوصل بالكهرباء'.

questions.question: Thieves broke ______ their house and stole the video.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Break into' = يقتحم. 'broke into their house' = اقتحموا منزلهم. 'Break out' تعني 'يهرب'، و'Break off' تعني 'ينكسر'، و'Break down' تعني 'يتعطل'.

questions.question: Their car broke ______ on the way to the airport.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Break down' = يتعطل. 'broke down on the way' = تعطلت في الطريق. 'Break out' و'Break into' و'Break off' لا تناسب السيارة.

questions.question: The couple broke ______ five years after getting married.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Break up' = ينفصل. 'broke up five years after' = انفصلا بعد خمس سنوات. 'Break out' تعني 'يهرب'، و'Break off' تعني 'ينكسر'.

questions.question: Two prisoners broke ______ of the prison.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Break out' = يهرب. 'broke out of prison' = هربا من السجن. 'Break into' تعني 'يقتحم'، و'Break off' تعني 'ينكسر'.

questions.question: I finish work ______ 7:50.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'At' مع الوقت المحدد. 'at 7:50' = في الساعة 7:50. 'in' تستخدم مع الشهور والسنوات، و'on' مع الأيام، و'by' تعني 'بحلول'.

questions.question: My mother was born ______ 1948.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'In' مع السنة. 'in 1948' = في عام 1948. 'on' مع الأيام، و'at' مع الساعات، و'by' تعني 'بحلول'.

questions.question: I will give you back that money ______ the end of the month.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'At the end of' = في نهاية. 'at the end of the month' = في نهاية الشهر. 'in' تستخدم مع 'the middle'، و'on' مع الأيام.

questions.question: We will be visiting my parents ______ April.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'In' مع الشهر. 'in April' = في أبريل. 'on' مع الأيام، و'at' مع الساعات، و'by' تعني 'بحلول'.

questions.question: Jane arrived ______ midnight.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'At' مع منتصف الليل. 'at midnight' = في منتصف الليل. 'in' مع الفترات الطويلة، و'on' مع الأيام.

questions.question: My plane leaves ______ Saturday.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'On' مع الأيام. 'on Saturday' = يوم السبت. 'in' مع الشهور، و'at' مع الساعات، و'by' تعني 'بحلول'.

questions.question: The elevator is out of ______ today.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Out of order' = معطل. 'the elevator is out of order' = المصعد معطل. 'out of work' تعني 'عاطل'، و'out of operation' تعني 'خارج الخدمة'.

questions.question: I'm afraid this car doesn't have enough ______ to get up that hill.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Power' = قوة. السيارة تحتاج قوة كافية لتسلق التل. 'Motor' و'Engine' هما أجزاء من السيارة، و'Charge' تعني 'شحن'.

questions.question: How he manages to keep going is ______ me.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Beyond me' = يفوق فهمي. 'How he manages is beyond me' = كيف يدبر أمره يفوق فهمي. 'Beneath' و'Below' و'Beside' لا تعبر عن هذا المعنى.

questions.question: The ______ of the forest will result in the ______ of many species.
questions.explanation: 🔍 نحتاج أسماء بعد 'the'. 'destruction' و'disappearance' هما الاسمين الصحيحين. 'Destructing' و'destruct' و'disappear' ليست أسماء.

questions.question: The incident has been witnessed by a number of ______.
questions.explanation: 🔍 جمع 'passer-by' هو 'passers-by'. نضيف 's' للكلمة الأولى (الاسم)، وليس للكلمة الثانية (حرف الجر).

questions.question: The new job will provide you with ______ experience.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Invaluable' = لا يُقدر بثمن. 'invaluable experience' = خبرة لا تُقدر بثمن. 'Praiseworthy' و'Admirable' و'Merit' لا تناسب هذا السياق.

questions.question: A funeral can ______ the feelings of regret and loss.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Amplify' = يضخم، يعزز. الجنازة تعزز مشاعر الحزن والفقدان. 'Extend' تعني 'يمدد'، و'Develop' تعني 'يطور'.

questions.question: He was left alone in the hospital, with ______ to take care of him.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'No one' = لا أحد. 'with no one to take care of him' = مع لا أحد ليعتني به. 'Anyone' و'Someone' تعنيان وجود شخص، و'Not one' غير صحيحة.

questions.question: The company did not have any ______ opening shops in Paris.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Profit' = ربح. 'did not have any profit' = لم يكن لديهم أي ربح. 'Winnings' و'Victory' و'Success' لا تعبر عن الربح المالي.

questions.question: I noticed that there were two buttons ______ from his coat.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Missing' = مفقودة. 'two buttons missing' = زرين مفقودين. 'Dropping' و'Falling' تعنيان 'يسقطان'، و'Loosing' تعني 'يفقدان'.

questions.question: I think I will ______ about this bad service.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Complain about' = يشتكي من. 'I will complain about this bad service' = سأشتكي من هذه الخدمة السيئة. 'Complaint' اسم، و'Think' و'Consider' لا تعبر عن الشكوى.

questions.question: Further research is needed to find out what side ______ this pill has.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Side effects' = آثار جانبية. 'side effects' هي التأثيرات الجانبية للدواء. 'Affects' فعل، و'Suspects' تعني 'مشتبه بهم'، و'Defects' تعني 'عيوب'.

questions.question: Oh I am so ______! Let's go and rent a video.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Fed up' = سئمت، ضجرت. 'I am so fed up!' = لقد سئمت جداً! 'Tiring' تعني 'مُتعب'، و'Happiness' اسم، و'Boring' تصف الشيء.

questions.question: I'm worried about the children's ______ on the street.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Safety' = سلامة. 'children's safety on the street' = سلامة الأطفال في الشارع. 'Noise' و'Freedom' و'Sanction' لا تعبر عن الخطر.

questions.question: If the fire alarm sounds, all residents are required to ______ in the courtyard.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Assemble' = يتجمعون. 'assemble in the courtyard' = يتجمعون في الفناء. 'Unite' و'Combine' و'Mobilise' لا تعبر عن التجمع.

questions.question: Many lakes, rivers and seas are being ______ polluted.
questions.explanation: 🔍 نحتاج حال (adverb). 'dangerously polluted' = ملوثة بشكل خطير. 'Dangers' و'Danger' و'Dangerous' ليست حالات.

questions.question: The film was a huge ______. It made 90 million dollars.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Success' = نجاح. 'a huge success' = نجاح كبير. 'Succeed' فعل، و'Hope' و'Money' لا تعبر عن النجاح.

questions.question: He gave the police the ______ of the stolen goods.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Description' = وصف. 'gave the police a description' = أعطى الشرطة وصفاً. 'Shape' و'Shadow' و'Explanation' لا تناسب.

questions.question: I don't like the ______ of the furniture in this room.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Arrangement' = ترتيب. 'the arrangement of the furniture' = ترتيب الأثاث. 'Way' تعني 'طريقة'، و'Staying' و'Compliment' لا تناسب.

questions.question: The ______ of the train will be 15 minutes late.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Departure' = موعد المغادرة. 'the departure of the train' = موعد مغادرة القطار. 'Coming' و'Use' و'Time' لا تعبر عن المغادرة.

questions.question: We cannot ______ children under 14 to go to movies without their parents.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Permit' = يسمح، وتأتي مع 'to'. 'permit children to go' = يسمح للأطفال بالذهاب. 'Let' و'Make' و'Have' تتبعها V1 بدون 'to'.

questions.question: I'd like to ______ you on passing your exam.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Congratulate' = يهنئ. 'congratulate you on passing' = أهنئك على النجاح. 'Thank' و'Excuse' و'Let' لا تعبر عن التهنئة.

questions.question: He ______ lives in the house where he was born.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Still' = ما زال. 'He still lives' = ما زال يعيش. 'Already' تعني 'بالفعل'، و'Yet' تستخدم في النفي، و'Every' تعني 'كل'.

questions.question: He was a good swimmer so he ______ swim to the river bank.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Was able to' = تمكن من (ونجح). 'was able to swim' = تمكن من السباحة. 'Could' تعبر عن قدرة عامة، و'Might' عن احتمالية، و'Succeeded to' خطأ.

questions.question: My brother ______ 65 kilos.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Weighs' = يزن. 'weighs 65 kilos' = يزن 65 كيلو. 'Masses' و'Makes' و'Pulls' لا تعبر عن الوزن.

questions.question: The people demonstrated for more ______.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Freedom' = حرية. 'demonstrated for freedom' = تظاهروا من أجل الحرية. 'Government' و'Oppression' و'Life' لا تعبر عن المطالب المعتادة.

questions.question: A problem of fundamental ______ for developing countries.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Of fundamental importance' = ذو أهمية أساسية. 'Vital' و'Urgent' و'Serious' صفات ولا تأتي بعد 'of' في هذا السياق.

questions.question: Larry is a friendly person. He meets new people ______ he goes.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Wherever' = أينما. 'wherever he goes' = أينما يذهب. 'Whenever' تعني 'كلما'، و'Whatever' و'Whoever' لا تعبر عن المكان.

questions.question: The people who objected were told there was no point in ______.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'No point in protesting' = لا فائدة من الاحتجاج. 'Contradicting' و'Provoking' و'Competing' لا تعبر عن الاحتجاج.

questions.question: Nursery schools can be enormously ______ to socially handicapped children.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Beneficial' = مفيد. 'beneficial to children' = مفيد للأطفال. 'Admirable' و'Invaluable' و'Meritorious' لا تعبر عن الفائدة بهذا الشكل.

questions.question: I don't think Alan is ______. Sherie is at home with him.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Lonely' = يشعر بالوحدة. 'Alan isn't lonely because Sherie is with him' = آلان ليس وحيداً لأن شيري معه. 'Alone' تعني 'بمفرده' (حالة فيزيائية).

questions.question: This documentation is not ______. You might be arrested.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Not legal' = غير قانوني. 'not legal documentation' = وثائق غير قانونية. 'Criminal' أقوى، و'Formal' و'Incorrect' لا تعبر عن المخالفة القانونية.

questions.question: Will you take the job? We must have a quick ______.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Have a quick decision' = نتخذ قراراً سريعاً. 'Decision' هو الاسم المناسب. 'Mind' و'Deciding' و'Manner' لا تعبر عن القرار.

questions.question: It was a(n) ______ film. I nearly fell asleep.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Boring' = ممل. 'boring film' = فيلم ممل، سبب النعاس. 'Interesting' و'Exciting' و'Relaxing' لا تسبب النعاس.

questions.question: We felt very ______ on holiday.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Relaxed' = مرتاح (صفة للشخص). 'We felt relaxed' = شعرنا بالراحة. 'Relaxing' تصف الشيء، و'Rest' و'Unrest' أسماء.

questions.question: Thanks to technology, a visit to the dentist is now often quite ______.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Painless' = غير مؤلم. 'painless visit' = زيارة غير مؤلمة. 'Harmless' و'Helpful' و'Tasty' لا تعبر عن الألم.

questions.question: The government is trying to help ______ families.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Homeless families' = عائلات بلا مأوى. هي الفئة التي تحتاج المساعدة. 'Rich' عكس المعنى، و'Social' و'Small' لا تعبر عن الحاجة.

questions.question: Thank you for the books. They will be very ______ for my studies.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Useful' = مفيد. 'useful for studies' = مفيدة للدراسة. 'Harmful' عكس المعنى، و'Tasteful' و'Hopeful' لا تناسب.

questions.question: The Sahara is a ______.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Desert' = صحراء. الصحراء الكبرى هي أكبر صحراء في العالم. 'River' و'Continent' و'Canal' لا تناسب.

questions.question: Shoes are usually made of ______.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Leather' = جلد. الأحذية تصنع عادة من الجلد. 'Wool' و'Paper' و'Iron' لا تستخدم في صناعة الأحذية.

questions.question: His father always says 'please' and 'thank you'. He is very ______.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Polite' = مهذب. استخدام 'please' و'thank you' يدل على الأدب. 'Impolite' و'Rude' عكس المعنى، و'Talkative' تعني 'ثرثار'.

questions.question: My sister is very careful about her appearance. She is a/an ______ lady.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Tidy' = مرتبة. 'tidy lady' = سيدة مرتبة. 'Silly' و'Unsociable' و'Cautious' لا تعبر عن الاهتمام بالمظهر.

questions.question: He always has good hopes for the future. He is very ______.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Optimist' = متفائل. 'optimist' هو الشخص الذي يرى المستقبل بإيجابية. 'Pessimist' عكس المعنى، و'Rude' و'Quiet' لا تناسب.

questions.question: Jake has a lot of common sense. He is a ______ boy.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Sensible' = عاقل. 'sensible boy' = ولد عاقل. 'Sensitive' و'Sensual' و'Nonsense' لا تعبر عن الحكمة.

questions.question: Lora only thinks about herself. She is ______.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Selfish' = أنانية. 'selfish person' = شخص أناني. 'Naughty' و'Patient' و'Genius' لا تعبر عن الأنانية.

questions.question: He is always happy and smiling. He is very ______.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Cheerful' = مبتهج. 'cheerful person' = شخص مبتهج. 'Hard-headed' و'Funny' و'Intelligent' لا تعبر عن السعادة.

questions.question: Madison doesn't like work. He is ______.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Lazy' = كسول. 'lazy person' = شخص كسول. 'Happy' و'Poor' و'Rich' لا تعبر عن كره العمل.

questions.question: My brother wants to get an important job. He is very ______.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Ambitious' = طموح. 'ambitious person' = شخص طموح. 'Stubborn' و'Learned' و'Talkative' لا تعبر عن الطموح.

questions.question: My friend loves to talk to people. He is ______.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Talkative' = ثرثار. 'talkative person' = شخص ثرثار. 'Ugly' و'Strong' و'Sad' لا تعبر عن حب الكلام.

questions.question: Peter never gets upset when things go wrong. He is a very ______ man.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Easy-going' = مرن، هادئ. 'easy-going man' = رجل هادئ. 'Hard-working' و'Attractive' و'Mad' لا تعبر عن الهدوء.

questions.question: He gets annoyed if he has to wait. He is very ______.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Impatient' = نفذ الصبر. 'impatient person' = شخص نفذ صبره. 'Sociable' و'Industrious' و'Hard' لا تعبر عن عدم الصبر.

questions.question: He likes new things and new places, even if dangerous. He is ______.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Adventurous' = مغامر. 'adventurous person' = شخص مغامر. 'Selfish' و'Clever' و'Mean' لا تعبر عن حب المغامرة.

questions.question: She loves meeting people. She is a very ______ person.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Sociable' = اجتماعي. 'sociable person' = شخص اجتماعي. 'Shy' و'Ignorant' و'Learned' لا تعبر عن حب الاجتماع.

questions.question: The music was too ______.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Loud' = صاخب. 'loud music' = موسيقى صاخبة. 'Small' و'Wrong' و'Incorrect' لا تصف الصوت.

questions.question: Mark is a ______ boy. Everyone likes him.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Polite' = مهذب. 'polite boy' = ولد مهذب يحبه الجميع. 'Hard' و'Rude' و'Bad' لا تجعل الشخص محبوباً.

questions.question: He is a ______ man. I do not want to speak to him.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Stupid' = غبي. 'stupid man' = رجل غبي لا يرغبون في التحدث معه. 'Clever' و'Gentle' و'Handsome' لا تسبب النفور.

questions.question: My belt is too ______. I couldn't loose it.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Tight' = ضيق. 'tight belt' = حزام ضيق يصعب فكه. 'Hard' و'Soft' و'Useful' لا تعبر عن صعوبة الفك.

questions.question: He was ______. He wasn't set free.
questions.explanation: 🔍 'Guilty' = مذنب. 'guilty person' = شخص مذنب لا يُطلق سراحه. 'Easy' و'Cheap' و'Weak' لا تعبر عن الذنب.
